headline: A firmer rupiah and sub-$100 oil extend the belly rally into the 10Y, down 1.5bp to 7.69%, and the flow signal edges out of sell-off (−0.49) a day before a Rp30tn SUN auction
summary: The rally moved out along the curve: PHEI's IGSYC 5Y fell 2.6bp to 7.446% and the 7Y 2.7bp to 7.600%, the 10Y 1.5bp to 7.689% and the 15–30Y about 0.6bp, while the front end gave a little back (1Y −0.4bp to 6.861%, 2Y +1.1bp to 7.058%, 1M +3.8bp to 6.36%). 2s5s flattened to 39bp and the 2s5s10s fly to 15bp, both the lowest of the eight PHEI days stored, while 5s10s held at 24bp, the steepest; month to date the 5Y is 7.5bp lower and the 10Y still 6bp higher. Benchmarks split: FR0108 fell 5bp to 7.581% and is now 10bp rich to the curve, FR0109 rose 1.1bp to 7.374% and sits on it. Sukuk followed the curve (fitted PBS 5Y 1.7bp through IGSYC; PBS034 −7.3bp and 10bp rich, PBS040 still 15.5bp cheap), the retail fit moved to 11bp rich at 5Y, and AAA 3Y held at 49bp over IGSYC.
drivers: Rupiah, oil and equities steadied, so duration got bid

JISDOR fixed at 18,103 (−0.15%) and spot closed near 18,085 as Brent slipped below $100 on hopes for a US–Iran settlement; the JCI rose 0.46% to 5,074 with foreigners net buyers of about Rp104bn by the midday break (full-day figure not yet out). The 4–7Y sector fell 1.4–2.7bp and the 10Y 1.5bp; who bought is not disclosed, so domestic real-money buying is a hypothesis. Last week's data still showed Rp2.29tn of non-resident SBN selling, so this is not yet foreign money coming back.

DJPPR auctions nine SUN series on Nov 10 for an indicative Rp30tn (up to Rp45tn), including a new 2047 bond, FR0113, after the Oct 27 auction drew only Rp31.09tn of bids and raised Rp20.65tn against the same target. The front end cheapened into it, and Friday's SRBI auction drew Rp36.89tn (from Rp55.91tn) with Rp7.5tn awarded and the 12-month yield up 7bp to 6.67%, so BI is still paying up at the short end.

The daily Bond Flow Signal rose to −0.49 from −0.94, just inside neutral, mostly because the rupiah's 20-session change fell to +0.55% (z −0.18) and the 10Y trend part eased (z +1.77); the JCI part (z −1.90) and the 283bp spread part (z +1.54) barely moved. The sell-off episode that began Oct 7 closed with the 10Y 52bp higher; it is still inside its 20-session scoring window.
US Treasuries: payrolls lifted UST yields, INDOGBs ignored it

Friday's 165k US payrolls (f 65k) lifted the US 10Y 2bp to 4.86% (Treasury close) and pushed December Fed-hike odds near 80%; at the 1-year daily beta of 0.34 that implied +0.7bp for INDOGBs, yet the 10Y fell 1.5bp, so Treasuries explain none of today's move. Over four weeks the INDOGB 10Y is up 52bp while the US 10Y is down 24bp (26-week weekly beta −0.21: about +5bp is the Treasury-linked part and +47bp is residual, which is what the US move does not explain, not proof of domestic selling or political risk); the INDOGB − UST spread is 283bp, 96th percentile of 52 weeks, a nominal pick-up before currency risk.
data: Better but below 121.2 a year ago; no change to BI's rupiah-first reaction function.
Raised December Fed-hike odds and the US 2Y; INDOGBs looked through it today, but a hike would narrow BI's room.
Up despite intervention. My read, not a BI commitment: BI can keep smoothing the rupiah near 18,100–18,200 before it has to hike.
A clear beat led by government spending: no growth case for an early cut, but it lowers the risk premium.
Non-resident SBN net buy Rp9.55tn; equity net sell Rp16.88tn; JCI −16.7% m/m
October's INDOGB sell-off was a price move more than a foreign exit; last week's Rp2.29tn of SBN selling shows October inflows do not rule out November outflows.
Bids Rp28.56tn, awarded Rp16.65tn (target Rp10tn); bid-to-cover 1.71x
Demand concentrated in short tenors; a decent sukuk auction sets a low bar for Tuesday's SUN sale.
Softer than expected: inflation does not force BI's hand; the rupiah does.
view: The rally is spreading from the belly toward duration, but it rests on a calmer rupiah and cheaper oil rather than returning foreign money, and the week's tests are all ahead: the SUN auction (Nov 10), US CPI (Nov 10), MSCI's review (Nov 11, read in Jakarta Nov 12) and BI (Nov 17–18). The daily Bond Flow Signal is −0.49, neutral by 0.01 after the 15-session sell-off episode that began Oct 7 (10Y +52bp); the JCI (z −1.90) and 10Y trend (z +1.77) still lean bearish, the rupiah part is flat (z −0.18) and the 283bp Treasury spread, 42bp above its 130-day average (z +1.54), is the bullish part; in about ten sessions the window drops the pre-MSCI levels, so at unchanged prices the JCI and trend parts ease further. On the daily build since June 2022 the signal scores a Sharpe of 0.75 outright and 0.90 hedged against Treasuries, with rally calls right 58% and sell-off calls 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (hedged 62% and 51%); the weekly build scores 0.33 and 0.44, and the US-trend variants reach 0.73 and 0.78 on the weekly build but were chosen after the fact and are not live; all are in-sample back-tests. Treasuries explain only about 5bp of the 52bp four-week rise, so the turn depends on the residual, the rupiah, BI and MSCI. Following the rule set on Friday, I move the 10Y from underweight to neutral now that the signal is above −0.5, and would go back underweight if it drops below −0.5 with the 10Y above 7.75%; I expect 7.55–7.80% over the next two weeks. On the curve, the belly has richened (fly at 15bp, the lowest stored), so I would not chase 5Y outright and keep the FR0109 → PBS040 switch, now 1.5bp against.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y slipped 0.4bp to 6.861%, 111bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate (38th percentile of eight stored days, average 112bp) and 186bp over the 5.00% deposit facility; the 2Y rose 1.1bp to 7.058%, so 1s2s steepened to 20bp. The 1M point rose 3.8bp to 6.36% and the 3M (0.25Y) is 6.45%, below Friday's 12-month SRBI at 6.67%. Previous call (add at 1Y 7.10%) still open and unfilled, 24bp away.
buckets.call: Neutral. Keep the plan: add 1–2Y if the 1Y reaches 7.10% or once BI has hiked and JISDOR holds below 18,000; avoid chasing below 6.75%.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y fell 2.6bp to 7.446%, the lowest of eight stored days (25th percentile, average 7.520%), and is 7.5bp lower this month; the 2s5s10s fly is 15bp, also the lowest stored (average 29bp). FR0109 rose 1.1bp to 7.374% and now sits on the curve; PBS040 fell 1.1bp to 7.489% (15.5bp over IGSYC). The FR0109 → PBS040 switch, entered at 10bp, is now 11.5bp (13.7bp Friday): 1.5bp against, 4.5bp from the stop. The outright entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) was not filled.
buckets.call: Keep the switch (sell FR0109 / buy PBS040), target 4bp, stop 16bp. Outright: buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%. Not chasing at a 15bp fly.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y fell 1.5bp to 7.689%, still the 97th percentile of the past year (172 days, average 6.78%) and 3.6bp off the 7.724% high of Nov 4. The underweight from the Oct 7 sell-off signal (10Y then 7.17%) closes 52bp in the right direction: the signal rose to −0.49, above the −0.5 neutral trigger set on Friday, though the 7.60% half-cover level was not reached. FR0108 fell 5bp to 7.581%, 10bp rich to the curve.
buckets.call: Neutral. Go back underweight if the signal falls below −0.5 with the 10Y above 7.75%; tactical long only above 7.85% (stop 8.05%) or once the signal is above 0 with JISDOR below 18,000.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s steepened to 2.5bp (highest of eight stored days, average 0.9bp) as the 10Y outpaced the 20Y (−0.6bp). The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 widened to 10.2bp from 3.4bp as FR0108 richened 5bp and FR0107 cheapened 1.7bp, so the steepener re-entry at −5bp moved further away.
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted only at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp; at 10bp the benchmark curve already prices it.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: Neutral long end; PBS040 in the belly
buckets.why: The fitted PBS 5Y is 1.7bp through IGSYC (43rd percentile of seven stored days, average −2.3bp) and the 10Y 1.2bp through; the fit rests on four series (level −0.6bp, slope −2.9bp), so confidence is limited. PBS034 fell 7.3bp to 7.603% and is now 10.5bp rich (4.1bp Friday), PBS038 rose 0.5bp to 7.715% and PBS030 0.9bp to 6.896%. The switch-back condition (PBS034 5bp cheap) is further away.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034 at the long end; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to the curve. In the belly, keep sell FR0109 / buy PBS040 (entry 10bp, now 11.5bp, target 4bp, stop 16bp; size small, PBS040 trades less).

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y was flat at 7.692%, 49.3bp over IGSYC, the tightest of seven stored days (14th percentile, average 51.2bp). AA is 86bp over and A 156bp, both steady, and BBB holds at 235bp over AA (average 247bp). Steady tightening fits continued local demand, but buyer-level data is not published, so that is a hypothesis; with seven days stored the meter is thin. The add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah stabilises; tight spreads are not a reason to chase.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve is 10.7bp through IGSYC at 5Y, the least rich of seven stored days (average −15.2bp), and 10.5bp over at 2Y; today's fit uses 22 series (28 Friday) with a steep 80bp slope, so part of the move is the fit, not trading. Secondary spreads run from 62bp rich (SR022T3) to 31bp cheap (ORI027T3, up 12bp in a day); ORI026T6 is 7.563%, 24bp over IGSYC. ST017 is open until Dec 2 with floors of 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), below the IGSYC 2Y at 7.06% and 4Y at 7.33%.
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 offer more yield with daily liquidity; ST017's floor suits only hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, ~24bp over IGSYC).

igs:2.note: +1bp; front end cheapened into the auction

retail:2.note: 10bp over IGSYC on a refit; ST017 floor 6.95%

retail:5.note: 11bp rich; least rich of seven days

watch: Next: SUN auction with new FR0113 (Tue Nov 10), US October CPI and the US 10Y auction (Tue Nov 10), MSCI's November index review (Nov 11 US time, read in Jakarta early Nov 12), US PPI (Fri Nov 13), then BI's board meeting (Nov 17–18); a weak auction or JISDOR above 18,200 would pull the signal back toward sell-off, a rupiah below 18,000 would push a BI hike out.
